## Comparison

**1) Background/decorations**
- Both sides: white page with light-gray rectangular panel on the right side of each page. Panel size and position match. ✓

**2) Centered gate design elements**
- Title "הקדמונת וכללים" — same two-line display font, same size, same vertical position on both sides. ✓
- Decorative flourish/divider (thin rule with center diamond) below the title — identical on both sides. ✓

**3) Text positions**
- Subtitle ("יוסף שבת - גריי מלאכת - הוצאה" / "– רשיונות") sits at the same vertical height and centering on both sides.
- **Difference:** font weight/size — LEFT subtitle appears in a lighter/regular weight; RIGHT subtitle is noticeably **bolder and slightly larger**.

**4) Overall parity**
- Layout, gate composition, title, ornament, and gray background panel all match; only the subtitle weight/size differs.

## Verdict

**DIFFERENCES list:**
1. Subtitle text weight: LEFT = regular/light, RIGHT = bold.
2. Subtitle size slightly larger on RIGHT.

Everything else — title, divider ornament, positioning, background panel — is in parity.
